headline: Operations become intelligence.
lead: Sidón connects what people do, what systems detect, and what the operation needs to understand.
introMeta: A connected solution for understanding and improving daily operations.
categoriesLead: Each category addresses a distinct operational need. Together, they create a shared view of the operation while allowing each project to use only the modules it needs.
categoryInstructions: Five-category Sidón carousel. Use the arrow keys or buttons to change categories. Activate a card to view its modules.
connectedTitle: Each module addresses a specific need. Sidón connects them within one operation.
connectedLead: A project can begin with one module, one category, or a combination designed around its operational reality.
conversationTitle: Talk to us about your operation
conversationLead: We can begin with one module, one category, or an operational need that does not yet have a name.
conversationAction: Talk to us about your operation

mantiz.headline: Maintenance needs order before it can produce results.
mantiz.lead: Mantiz brings assets, requests, work orders, and technical execution into one process. Every intervention retains ownership, evidence, costs, and history for better control and planning.

flow.title: One asset, from need to history.
flow.intro: The journey shows how a preventive or corrective need becomes completed, reviewed, and traceable work.

stages.name: Need linked to the asset
stages.description: A preventive plan or corrective request is recorded with the equipment's context.
stages.sceneCopy: From the outset, the need is connected to the equipment's location, information, and history.

stages.name: Work order and assignment
stages.description: The need becomes a work order and is assigned to the appropriate person.
stages.sceneCopy: The order brings together scope, priority, timing, and resources so work stays coordinated.

stages.name: Field execution
stages.description: The technical team carries out the work and documents time, comments, photographs, and spare parts.
stages.sceneCopy: What was done is supported by field information that makes it possible to verify the work and understand its cost.

stages.name: Review and close
stages.description: The intervention is reviewed, approved, and updates the asset's service history.
stages.sceneCopy: The resolution, costs, and evidence remain available to identify recurring patterns and plan better.

talos.headline: Every incident needs an owner and a clear response.
talos.lead: Talos turns each report into a visible process that connects assessment, investigation, containment, and evidence until all required actions meet the closing criteria.

flow.title: One incident, until its resolution is verified.
flow.intro: The sequence follows a case from the initial report to a controlled and documented close.

stages.name: Report and assessment
stages.description: The incident is recorded with a description, photographs, and an initial assessment.
stages.sceneCopy: The case starts with identity, context, and sufficient evidence to begin an organized response.

stages.name: Investigation and severity
stages.description: What happened is documented and the case is classified under the operation's configured workflow.
stages.sceneCopy: The investigation gathers the information needed to determine the required actions.

stages.name: Containment and actions
stages.description: Actions are distributed among responsible people and each advance is supported by evidence.
stages.sceneCopy: Each person documents what was done; actions return to the central record without fragmenting follow-up.

stages.name: Validation and close
stages.description: The case closes only after required actions and criteria have been completed.
stages.sceneCopy: The close retains decisions, ownership, and evidence as a clear response history.

smartAudits.headline: Clear evidence makes audits more reliable.
smartAudits.lead: Smart Audits organizes scheduled tasks, protects photo capture, and analyzes evidence with Duma AI. The auditor retains the final decision and can request a new execution when the standard is not met.

flow.title: One task, from evidence to correction.
flow.intro: The flow brings together real operational changes: capturing valid evidence, making a controlled decision, and completing or repeating the task.

stages.name: Protected capture
stages.description: The person receives the task, takes photographs in the app, and Duma AI checks that the evidence is clear and usable.
stages.sceneTitle: Evidence is protected from the first moment.
stages.sceneCopy: The standard and the capture appear within the same composition. When the image is not sufficient, a new capture is requested before submission.

stages.name: Analysis and decision
stages.description: Duma AI analyzes the observed condition and presents the result to the auditor, who retains the final verdict.
stages.sceneCopy: The analysis adds consistency without approving or rejecting automatically. The decision of whether it complies remains visibly under human control.

stages.name: Completion or reassignment
stages.description: The task is completed when it meets the standard or reassigned to correct it and document it again.
stages.sceneTitle: The finding remains active until it is addressed.
stages.sceneCopy: The new execution returns to the same evidence-and-review cycle, preserving traceability of the result.

argos.headline: The operation can also be observed as it happens.
argos.lead: Argos uses Duma AI to analyze connected video and detect configured conditions as they occur. Each event retains evidence, context, and ownership until it becomes a resolved, searchable case.

flow.title: One event, from detection to resolution.
flow.intro: The sequence begins when a relevant condition appears and follows the case through its close and incorporation into history.

stages.name: Detection and evidence
stages.description: Duma AI identifies a configured condition and preserves evidence with a date, time, camera, and area.
stages.sceneCopy: The comparison takes place within a stable camera field, preserving operational context without resorting to a massive surveillance view.

stages.name: Case and response
stages.description: The event becomes a case, is notified, and is assigned to the person responsible for addressing it.
stages.sceneCopy: The record connects the observed condition with responsibility, actions taken, and follow-up progress.

stages.name: Resolution and history
stages.description: The case is resolved and remains available as historical evidence for follow-up, comparison, or audit.
stages.sceneTitle: Every event leaves a verifiable history.
stages.sceneCopy: The resolution preserves the full context and makes it possible to recognize recurring conditions across areas or locations.

nodIa.headline: Every display should show what the operation expects.
nodIa.lead: NOD-IA continually compares visible displays with the planogram to detect missing SKUs. When inventory context is available, it helps distinguish replenishment needs from supply conditions.

flow.title: One shortage, until availability is restored.
flow.intro: The journey compares what is expected with what is observed, adds the available context, and visually verifies the product's recovery.

stages.name: Comparison and detection
stages.description: NOD-IA compares the display with the planogram and identifies the SKU and position where there is a shortage.
stages.sceneTitle: What is expected and what is visible no longer match.
stages.sceneCopy: A single composition shows the expected position and the observed space, avoiding a separation of two visually almost identical moments.

stages.name: Context and response
stages.description: When connected inventory is available, the shortage is directed to local replenishment or supply follow-up.
stages.sceneCopy: Recorded availability helps distinguish an execution issue from a broader supply condition.

stages.name: Replenishment and verification
stages.description: The person confirms the action and monitoring verifies that the product is visible again.
stages.sceneCopy: The restored position closes the cycle and preserves recovery time for later analysis.

rondines.headline: Every round should leave proof that it happened.
rondines.lead: Rondines validates every point on a route with QR codes, location, and photos taken in the app. The operation retains coverage evidence even when part of the route occurs offline.

flow.title: One round, verified point by point.
flow.intro: The route is summarized in validation, continuity, and close. Offline operation is included as a possible condition, not as a mandatory step.

stages.name: Start and point validation
stages.description: The person starts the route and validates each checkpoint with a QR code, location, and a photograph taken in the app.
stages.sceneTitle: Each point proves that it was checked.
stages.sceneCopy: The start of the route and the first validation are shown together to establish how presence and inspection are verified.

stages.name: Route continuity
stages.description: The route advances point by point and stores evidence locally when it crosses an area without connection.
stages.sceneCopy: The following checkpoints show controlled repetition. If the signal is lost, the evidence remains protected until it can be synchronized.

stages.name: Completion and record
stages.description: The round ends with completed and pending points, duration, photographs, and observations available.
stages.sceneCopy: Synchronization, when it was needed, is part of the close and does not require an independent visual stage.

wellness.headline: Organized care to care better for every person.
wellness.lead: Wellness connects scheduling, consultations, and occupational medical records within one care history. Every visit updates authorized context to provide continuity without exposing clinical information to unauthorized profiles.

flow.title: One appointment, within a continuous history.
flow.intro: The journey keeps the record at its center and groups optional consultation outcomes within the same care moment.

stages.name: Request and scheduling
stages.description: Care is requested and the specialty, professional, and time are defined, including authorization only when the process requires it.
stages.sceneTitle: Care begins with the right context.
stages.sceneCopy: The person's need connects with service availability without presenting approval as a universal condition.

stages.name: Consultation and care outcome
stages.description: The professional conducts the consultation and, when applicable, records treatment, a prescription, medication, or leave.
stages.sceneTitle: Every consultation continues the same history.
stages.sceneCopy: The different outcomes appear as possible branches of care, not as steps every person must follow.

stages.name: Follow-up and record
stages.description: Progress is recorded and the record is updated for future authorized care.
stages.sceneCopy: The medical team retains continuity, while other profiles receive only the operational information that corresponds to them.

byblos.headline: Learning better also means being better prepared.
byblos.lead: Byblos organizes training, practice, evaluation, and certification through interactive journeys adapted to each role. The operation can verify progress, knowledge, and validity without reducing learning to passive content.

flow.title: From content to demonstrable readiness.
flow.intro: The flow distinguishes learning, verification, and certification, integrating journey assignment into the start of the experience.

stages.name: Journey and interactive learning
stages.description: The person receives a journey related to their role, reviews the content, makes decisions, and practices.
stages.sceneTitle: Every responsibility needs a different experience.
stages.sceneCopy: Assignment and the first activity form one moment centered on the knowledge the person needs to apply.

stages.name: Evaluation and feedback
stages.description: An activity checks understanding through questions, decisions, or practical evidence and shows what needs reinforcement.
stages.sceneCopy: Feedback connects practice with a verifiable outcome without reducing the experience to a passive presentation.

stages.name: Certification and validity
stages.description: When requirements are met, certification is issued and the defined validity and renewal period begins.
stages.sceneCopy: The outcome retains the person, journey, date, validity, and next renewal as a capability that can be followed.

axessOne.headline: Access begins before someone reaches the door.
axessOne.lead: AxessOne connects preregistration, document validation, permissions, and access control for people and vehicles. Each entry retains the context needed to confirm that the right person enters under the right conditions.

flow.title: One entry, from invitation to verified access.
flow.intro: The sequence prepares the visit, verifies requirements, and records entry and exit.

stages.name: Preregistration and invitation
stages.description: The visit is created with its purpose, person or vehicle details, and the information required for access.
stages.sceneCopy: The operation can prepare the visit with the context it needs.

stages.name: Validation and authorization
stages.description: Documents, requirements, and permissions are reviewed according to the configured access process.
stages.sceneCopy: The process confirms whether the visit meets the conditions for access.

stages.name: Entry, exit, and record
stages.description: The access point records entry and exit, preserving the visit history.
stages.sceneCopy: The operation can verify who entered, when, and under which authorization.

sense.headline: A changing condition needs a connected response.
sense.lead: Sense monitors variables from connected equipment, generates alerts, and helps the operation act before a condition becomes a larger problem.

flow.title: One condition, from signal to action.
flow.intro: The flow connects detection, notification, and an operational response with a record of what happened.

stages.name: Connected signal
stages.description: A connected device reports the variable or condition being monitored.
stages.sceneCopy: Continuous data makes relevant changes visible as they occur.

stages.name: Alert and context
stages.description: When a configured threshold is reached, Sense generates an alert with the relevant context.
stages.sceneCopy: The alert connects the condition with the equipment and its operational context.

stages.name: Action and follow-up
stages.description: The responsible team responds and retains the action and outcome for follow-up.
stages.sceneTitle: A signal becomes an operational response.
stages.sceneCopy: The history supports learning from recurring conditions.

polar.headline: Transport conditions need to remain visible throughout the journey.
polar.lead: Polar records temperature, location, and door status to monitor and certify transport conditions from departure to delivery.

flow.title: One journey, with conditions under control.
flow.intro: The sequence observes the trip, identifies deviations, and preserves evidence for delivery and review.

stages.name: Departure and monitoring
stages.description: The trip begins with the required transport conditions and connected monitoring.
stages.sceneTitle: The journey begins with a reference.
stages.sceneCopy: Temperature, location, and door status establish the expected operating context.

stages.name: Condition and deviation
stages.description: Polar detects changes that require attention and retains their time and location.
stages.sceneCopy: The operation can understand when and where a condition changed.

stages.name: Delivery and certification
stages.description: The journey closes with a record of the observed conditions and supporting evidence.
stages.sceneCopy: The complete history supports delivery review and certification.

industrial.headline: Production improves when losses have a clear place to be seen.
industrial.lead: Industrial connects production data, equipment states, stops, cycles, and quality to reveal availability, performance, and quality losses in real time.

flow.title: From live production to a prioritized loss.
flow.intro: The sequence establishes the target, shows how capacity is lost, and brings OEE together with the opportunity that deserves attention.

stages.name: Production against a target
stages.description: Production is viewed in the context of the line, shift, product, pace, and expected target.
stages.sceneCopy: Live status and progress against plan make losses easier to interpret.

stages.name: Observed losses
stages.description: Stops, micro-stops, slow cycles, and rejects show how availability, performance, and quality decrease.
stages.sceneTitle: Every loss has a production impact.
stages.sceneCopy: The three dimensions remain connected to their cause, duration, and effect.

stages.name: OEE and priority loss
stages.description: Industrial brings together the three dimensions and highlights the one reducing shift capacity the most.
stages.sceneTitle: The result shows where improvement should focus.
stages.sceneCopy: OEE and the highest-impact loss converge in the final view.

mantenimiento-seguridad.name: Maintenance and Safety
mantenimiento-seguridad.headline: Keep assets available. Keep incidents under control.
mantenimiento-seguridad.intro: Organizes maintenance and incident management with clear workflows, defined ownership, and progress the entire operation can see.
mantenimiento-seguridad.solves: It brings structure to two essential operational responsibilities: keeping assets available and ensuring every incident receives attention, follow-up, and a documented resolution.

mantiz.name: Mantiz
mantiz.description: Keeps preventive and corrective work organized so assets remain available.

talos.name: Talos
talos.description: Manages incidents with reporting, containment, cause analysis, corrective actions, evidence, and escalation based on severity.

auditorias.name: Audits
auditorias.headline: Execution should be verifiable.
auditorias.intro: Verifies standards, detects deviations, and preserves reliable operational evidence.
auditorias.solves: Shows whether an activity, condition, or round was completed correctly and preserves evidence for follow-up.

smartAudits.name: Smart Audits
smartAudits.description: Photo-based audits with capture validation and Duma-assisted analysis.

argos.name: Argos
argos.description: Duma analyzes live video to detect configured conditions and preserve evidence.

nodIa.name: NOD-IA
nodIa.description: Uses AI to detect product gaps across shelves, displays, refrigerators, and other merchandising spaces.

rondines.name: Rondines
rondines.description: Verifies security rounds with QR codes, geolocation, and photo evidence.

personas.name: People
personas.headline: People cared for. Teams prepared.
personas.intro: Supports each person’s wellbeing and prepares them to participate in the operation with confidence.
personas.solves: People cannot do their best work without the care they need and the preparation their role requires.

wellness.name: Wellness
wellness.description: Organizes and manages medical appointments and occupational medical records to support each person’s wellbeing with privacy and continuity.

byblos.name: Byblos
byblos.description: Delivers training and certifications through interactive, game-like experiences tailored to each role.

acceso.name: Access
acceso.headline: The right person. The right access.
acceso.intro: Organizes and validates access for visitors, employees, contractors, suppliers, and vehicles.
acceso.solves: A door does not control access on its own. The operation needs to know who may enter, confirm that all requirements are met, and preserve evidence of every entry.

axessOne.name: AxessOne
axessOne.description: Unifies preregistration, document validation, permissions, and access control for people and vehicles.

monitoreo.name: Monitoring
monitoreo.headline: See what matters. Act in time.
monitoreo.intro: Monitors assets, processes, and conditions with continuous data, alerts, and connected action.
monitoreo.solves: When conditions change unnoticed, the operation reacts too late.

sense.name: Sense
sense.description: Monitors variables, generates alerts, and enables action across connected equipment.

polar.name: Polar
polar.description: Monitors and certifies transport conditions through temperature, location, and door-status records.

industrial.name: Industrial
industrial.description: An OEE platform that connects PLCs, meters, equipment, and process variables to measure availability, performance, and quality.
